images.title: One resource, one stable plot
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity Board design review screenshot, wide landscape 16:9 desktop.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND UI FRAME REFERENCE ONLY: keep its warm ivory architectural material, dark teal readable typography, calm generous whitespace, slim header and unobtrusive corner controls. Replace the process fabric with the requested RESOURCE CITYSCAPE.
Primary request: a beautiful abstract cityscape of durable data resources, combining Manhattan-like concentrated tall buildings, borough-like medium blocks, and suburban-like low sparse buildings as visual densities, without depicting actual New York geography or recognizable landmarks.
Visual grammar: architectural massing models, solid ivory and muted blue-grey structures with fine teal details; no glass photorealism, windows with people, cars, literal roads, rivers or geographical claims. The surface is a flat warm ivory map with stable rounded territory seams. Buildings have hard architectural edges and stand on flat plots, clearly distinct from soft process wells. High oblique cartographic view, roof surfaces visible, moderate height compression so buildings do not occlude everything behind them. Use generous open spaces and no floor-by-floor numerical precision.
Resource types do NOT predetermine size: Tables use regular rectangular slab forms with fine grid facades; KV uses modular cubic forms with subtle repeated compartments; proposed Documents use stepped or nested terraces with folded/layered tops. A large KV or Document can be taller than a Table. Motifs are restrained structural identities, not renderings of application content. Building footprint is stable layout space, NOT a value/row count or storage metric. Height is the one selected quantitative measure, current value bytes on a compressed scale, with exact values available on selection.
UI: one slim 56px header. Board at left with specified scope breadcrumb; one central search field "Search processes or resources"; one small Map / Browse switch at right with Map selected. Under header, left align the specified population once in 22px type. Tiny "Synthetic · complete" status alongside the population. Keep the rest of the page a full-width map. No left rail, permanent sidebar, large page title, mini-map, ranking panel or duplicated summary cards. Bottom left one compact combined legend with dropdown chevron: "Resources · Current value bytes" and smaller "Height: compressed · Footprint: layout". Bottom right small minus, plus, reset view controls and Evidence button. Tiny footer "Concept · synthetic data".
Keep labels sparse, all specified text readable, generous map margins. No amber age coloration unless specifically requested. No random metrics, chart axes, decorative annotations or process queues in a resource-only scene. These are synthetic concept massings, not implemented screens or exact plots.

Header scope: "Atlas / A.01". Population: "48 resources".
Draw approximately forty-eight distinct resource plots arranged in three calm adjoining neighborhoods across the broad canvas. Each plot contains ONE architectural building. Dense center-left has a mixed skyline of roughly sixteen taller varied structures, the middle/right has medium borough-like blocks, and the lower/front edge has low sparse pavilions with generous space. Avoid a regular chessboard or dozens of identical skyscrapers. There are no enclosing high platforms under whole neighborhoods; every individual resource stands on the common flat base. Use thin quiet plot outlines and larger rounded neighborhood seams.
The tallest landmark is a stepped Document, a second very tall landmark is modular KV, and there is a slightly lower tall rectangular Table nearby: all three kinds can be large. Label these landmarks discreetly "Document", "KV", "Table". One small pair of Table wings on a shared site can be present among medium plots, but do not label them. No selection card open. Dense-to-sparse character should be immediately legible and beautiful without literal Manhattan shapes. Keep buildings low enough in projection that the map remains readable.

refinements.prompt: Edit only decorative landscaping in this Board resource map. Remove ALL trees, bushes and planted greenery from every plot. Leave those areas as quiet flat ivory negative space. Preserve ALL buildings, all geometry of the resource plots and group outlines, the Table/KV/Document labels, every UI label, header and controls unchanged. This is a data map; vegetation has no data meaning. Do not replace the trees with other decorative objects.
